message.content: The most celebrated sculpture of the 19th century is generally considered to be **“The Kiss” (Le Baiser) by Auguste Rodin** (1889). It epitomises the era’s shift toward expressive, emotionally charged forms and remains one of the most iconic works of modern sculpture.
